title: System connected but no data (Dexcom G4)
body:
Hello,
It's been a week now that I can not receive data on the xdrip + app with a "missed signal", which has been working perfectly for several months (Libre Blucon and now DexcomG4). Strangely, I feel that this coincides with the use of a car with bluetooth. At first, I changed the sensor, and it did not change anything.
However, the system worked again for a few hours after the sensor restarted a few days later, but the reception of the first 3 readings took more than one night.
I installed Xdrip + on another phone and the result was similar. I can always control my pump with my phone, so the bluetooth is functional (Samsung Xcover4).
I tested several settings proposed in the posts about the problems of connection with Samsung phones. I have also reinstalled the latest version of Xdrip +, without improvement.
I specify that the transmitter is recent. To check its status, I reconnected the dexcom receiver to my transmitter. I can get the blood glucose again on the dexcom.
When I use "forget device" with a scan, the app detects my Xdrip Kit receiver.
Sometimes, bluetooth pairing is disabled, sometimes, not bonded...
Next to this message, 3 screenshots:
Could someone give me his opinion on the situtation?
Thanks!
The use of xdrip + / android APS (open loop) (+ ketogenic diet) were the most important discoveries for the management of my diabetes....A big thanks for that! 
Thomas

Connection OK !!!!!!
I will wait few hours just to be sure, and then I will close this issue.
Thomas

A few minutes after plugging my smartphone to recharge, the connection has stopped.
Since (24h), I have only received 15 minutes of data.
the Samsung workaround is unchecked, yet still visible and used...
